system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you would use Phantom’s Grip, you shape your phantasmal chakra into the shape of claw of your description to tear through your target’s chakra coils by spending 1 Superiority Die. If the affected creature would gain a rank of Concussed from Phantom’s Grip, then they also gain 1 rank of Sealed. If you use this maneuver as part of an attack while Hidden or the target is Unaware of you, they make their saving throw at disadvantage and on a failed save they gain +1 rank of Concussed and 2 total ranks of Sealed instead.
